# Tender Response -- KMK-2026-03

**3.1 LUSA qualification.** Visakoivu holds a valid LUSA-patevyys for LVI and electrical contracting, valid until 31 March 2027.

**3.2 Turnover.** Visakoivu's turnover for the most recently closed financial year (2025) was EUR 20,300,000, well above the EUR 5,000,000 threshold.

**4.1 Handover.** The asset register and associated documentation will be handed over at contract start and reviewed jointly with the client twice a year to keep it current.

**4.2 SLA.** Emergency faults: 4-hour response. Urgent faults: 24-hour response. Routine work: completion within 5 working days.

**4.3 Envelope inspection.** Annual inspection of roofing, facades and windows, combining a visual walkthrough with thermal imaging of the facades, reported to the client with photographs.

**4.4 Commissioning.** All equipment replacement or repair is followed by function testing and a written sign-off before the work is closed.

**4.5 Warranty.** 24 months on installed equipment and replacement parts.

**5.1 Invoicing.** Monthly, by e-invoice.

**5.2 Contract period.** 3 years, with two 1-year extension options.

**6.1 Tender Form.** Completed Tender Form (Appendix 1) attached.

**6.2/6.3 Pricing.** Price quoted in EUR/m2/year. Unit basis: per property, applied consistently throughout this quotation and in the attached pricing schedule.

**Annex A.1.** Occupational safety plan attached.

**Annex A.2.** Spare parts availability and delivery times for the covered equipment types are described in the attached note.

**Annex A.3.** CVs of the proposed key personnel are attached.
